aquadon_desc: A small amphibious Zoid. Weak in direct combat, but easy to train and surprisingly quick.
barigator_desc: Republic amphibious crocodile-type. Replaced the Aquadon as the primary aquatic assault unit. Excels in ambushes — hiding submerged before striking with powerful bite fangs.
command_wolf_desc: A versatile Republic wolf-type Zoid. Well-balanced stats make it reliable in any situation.
crablaster_desc: A tiny crab-type Attack Zoid from the Empire's earliest deployments. Expendable and fragile, but easy to mass-produce for patrol and harassment.
crosswinger_desc: A small Republic aerial Zoid with twin-wing blades. Its strength lies in numbers, useful for espionage missions and valued for its speed.
dcsj_desc: The ultimate evolution of the Shield Liger line. Unmatched power and defense, but extremely difficult to master.
dragon_horse_desc: A rare non-combat horse-type Zoid originally used for transport and cavalry. Extremely fast to bond with, but nearly defenseless in battle.
elephantus_desc: Strong and tough, but slow and hard to pilot. Only for the bravest.
garius_desc: Simple and easy to control. Few offensive weapons, but if you take good care of him he will be unstoppable.
geruder_desc: A triceratops-type built to improve on the Malder's survivability. Heavy frontal armor and electromagnetic cannons make it a fearsome charging unit — a precursor to the mighty Red Horn.
giraffsworder_desc: A swift Zoid with blade-like extensions. Devastating attacks, but its thin armor makes it fragile.
glidoler_desc: Fast and strong, but fragile in combat. For experienced pilots.
goliath_desc: A small Empire snail-type Zoid with heavy armor and artillery fire. Despite its size, it can break through enemy lines like an armored vehicle.
gorgodos_desc: A sturdy Republic Zoid with thick armor. Slow to train, but it can endure what others cannot.
grandmolar_desc: A mole-type attack Zoid developed for special operations. With its massive power arm and spin drill, it can freely dig through the ground and launch surprise attacks from directly beneath the enemy.
gunbeetle_desc: A sturdy insect-type Zoid with solid defenses. Not the strongest, but reliable and easy to deploy.
hammerrock_desc: A heavy Empire Zoid that strikes with devastating force. Slow but incredibly tough.
helcat_desc: A stealthy Empire Zoid built for ambushes. Fast and agile with sharp claws, but not very durable.
helldiver_desc: A hammerhead shark-type Attack Zoid equipped with sonar and mini-torpedoes. Small but deadly underwater — a glass cannon that hits hard and breaks easily.
hidocker_desc: A large transport Zoid with thick armor. Very low attack power, but it can take a beating and provides good experience.
hyperscissors_desc: An amphibious crayfish-type designed for swamp operations. Its steel-cutting shears provide defense where the Aquadon provides offense — a sturdy complement in Republic aquatic squads.
red_horn_desc: The Empire's ultimate tank. Devastating firepower and nearly impenetrable armor, but extremely hard to master.
redler_desc: A fast aerial Zoid of the Empire. Deadly attack power, but its light frame makes it vulnerable.
saradin_desc: A Republic armadillo-type Zoid built to endure. Covered in special alloy and ceramic plating, it boasts exceptional survivability despite minimal offensive power. Almost impossible to destroy.
sea_batoras_desc: A horseshoe crab-type Attack Zoid with a low-profile body that evades radar. Remarkably fast in water and tougher than it looks — a stealthy scout for Republic carrier groups.
sea_panther_desc: An amphibious Empire Zoid designed for coastal operations. Tough and resilient, though not particularly fast.
sinker_desc: A sleek aquatic Zoid with high firepower. Glass cannon — hits hard but breaks easily.
spiker_desc: A nimble Republic Zoid that's easy to train and quick to bond with. Perfect for building a strong army fast.
stealth_viper_desc: A snake-type Republic Zoid that excels at quick strikes. Fast and deadly, with moderate durability.
